result.effect: GPT-3.5-Turbo consistently outperforms GPT-4o-Mini; no numerical effect size reported for this pair

cells.quote:
Under FSM metrics, however, GPT-3.5-Turbo consistently outperforms GPT-4o-Mini despite its lower nominal capacity.

While GPT-4o-Mini often produces functionally correct interfaces, these outputs frequently under-specify interaction states, resulting in fragmented or ambiguous transitions. In contrast, GPT-3.5-Turbo more consistently externalizes interaction structure in a stable, analyzable form, yielding higher FSM coverage and behavioral coherence.
cells.note: The comparison concerns AI-generated explorable explanations and automated FSM evaluation, not learner performance.
